Priya (CSM): Heads-up: Citrine QBR in 4 days. Their token spend spiked after enabling bulk embeddings. Need short 7/30 day forecast, renewal risk note, and quick mitigations to present.

BillingBot: ALERT Citrine Corp at 82% soft budget. Current tokens: 1,150,302 (+200%). Dashboard: https://app.redwood.io/accounts/citrine/usage

Leo (FinOps): Running numbers now. Quick ask: are calls mostly offline batch embeddings or interactive chat?

Sam (Onboarding): Mostly batch ingestion for vector search. They kicked off parallel jobs with high concurrency. We added a temporary ingest pool yesterday.

Maya (Product Eng): Short-term controls: throttle client concurrency, set max_batch_size=64, schedule ingestion to off-peak. Medium: recommend embedding-7b-int8.

Leo (FinOps): Quick forecast: 7d avg/day ~100k tokens -> baseline 30d ~3.0M. With current pattern projected ~4.3M (+240% M/M). Batching + off-peak could cut ~30% of token cost.

Priya (CSM): Please paste the SQL so I can put it on the QBR slide. Also owners for mitigations?

Leo (FinOps): SQL:
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage.events WHERE account_id = 'acct_Citrine' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

Priya (CSM): Owners: Leo -> finalize forecast and charts by Tue EOD. Maya -> runbook snippet + config by Tue EOD. Sam -> schedule a 30-min enablement with Citrine before QBR and check SLAs. I'll draft the slide and the renewal risk blurb.

BillingBot: NOTE: Citrine billing cycle restarts in 3 days. Auto-notify at 90% enabled.

Sam (Onboarding): Reached out to Citrine for an enablement slot, awaiting reply.

Priya (CSM): Thanks all. If conservative forecast still >100% increase, we'll mark as "activation-cost risk" in QBR. Otherwise aim to keep renewal green.

(End of thread)
